verdict.rationale: Firebase's own Local Emulator Suite runs Firestore, Realtime Database, Storage, Auth, Hosting and Functions locally. The docs say you can point an app at it for integration testing or QA "without touching production data." The Test SDK supports loading Security Rules, flushing the local database between tests, and running unit tests. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the emulator workflow; evidence that AI agents (e.g. via the MCP server) can target the emulator rather than live projects; GA status for the Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulators, which are still beta.
